mapper.select: select * from article order by num desc limit #{row},10

select a.num, a.title, a.content, a.writer, a.image_filename as imageFilename, a.viewcnt, a.download_filename as downloadFilename, m.profile, m.name as writerName from article a left join member m on(a.writer=m.id)
where writer like '%${keyword}%' or title like '%${keyword}%' or content like '%${keyword}%'
where ${type} like '%${keyword}%'
order by num desc limit #{row},10

select count(*) from article a left join member m on(a.writer=m.id)
where name like '%${keyword}%' or title like '%${keyword}%' or content like '%${keyword}%'
where ${type} like '%${keyword}%'
mapper.update: update article set viewcnt=viewcnt+1 where num=#{num}
